detail: Expected to start in Lu Dort's spot after OKC traded Dort, Joe and Wiggins
Final year of rookie deal, heading toward restricted free agency, wants a bigger role
Shares the ball with SGA, Jalen Williams and Ajay Mitchell
OKC must also find guard minutes for Ajay Mitchell, Jared McCain and Topic
About 1.9 steals per game projected, the clear outlier in his profile
No weak category flagged, but his value rests almost entirely on steals
Barely top 150 in points leagues; his ADP fits category value
